$comment: Checkout and subscriptions (src/domain/payments.ts, functions/billing/ops/checkout.ts + subscriptions.ts). Additive: the new schema Payment, new fields on Subscription and Coupon, the Subscription status past_due and three PlatformSetting keys (billing.provider default "coupon", billing.enforce default false, billing.internalWorkspaceIds default []) read with these defaults when absent. Apply expand-first on every tenant BEFORE deploying the web app, the functions or the engine worker. Validations: validations.json; indexes: indexes.json; policies: policies.json + rules.json (service writes only, super-admin reads, like the other billing schemas). Payment provider secrets live only on the function host / Blocks secrets, never in these schemas.

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: The organization (Workspace.ItemId) the payment is for.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the person who started the checkout (system for renewals).

fields.name: UserEmail
fields.description: E-mail of that person, for the receipt.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: new|upgrade|renewal.

fields.name: PlanKey
fields.description: Plan.Key paid for.

fields.name: FromPlanKey
fields.description: Plan.Key before an upgrade (empty otherwise).

fields.name: Provider
fields.description: Payment provider: coupon|blocks.

fields.name: ProviderRef
fields.description: The provider's reference (checkout/session/invoice id); never a secret.

fields.name: AmountUsd
fields.description: Due before codes, USD (monthly price, or the prorated difference of an upgrade).

fields.name: DiscountUsd
fields.description: Taken off by the code, USD.

fields.name: PaidUsd
fields.description: Collected by the provider, USD (0 when a code paid it all).

fields.name: CreditUsd
fields.description: Credit granted with this payment, USD.

fields.name: CouponCode
fields.description: The code applied (empty: none).

fields.name: Status
fields.description: open|paid|failed|expired|cancelled|refunded.

fields.name: ReceiptNo
fields.description: Receipt number of a paid payment (MF-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX).

fields.name: PeriodStart
fields.description: ISO start of the period paid.

fields.name: PeriodEnd
fields.description: ISO end of the period paid (the renewal day).

fields.name: PaidThroughAt
fields.description: ISO instant the code pays the plan through (empty: not paid ahead by a code).

fields.name: PaidAt
fields.description: ISO time the payment was settled.

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.description: ISO time an open checkout stops being answered again.

fields.name: Note
fields.description: Plain note (e.g. why a payment failed).

fields.name: DetailJson
fields.description: Server-written details (the code's terms, proration).

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key, set by the server; unique index.

fields.name: CurrentPeriodStart
fields.description: ISO start of the current paid period.

fields.name: PaidThroughAt
fields.description: ISO instant a code pays the plan through (renewals before it are paid by the code).

fields.name: CancelAtPeriodEnd
fields.description: True: the plan ends on RenewsAt and the organization moves to Free.

fields.name: NextPlanKey
fields.description: A downgrade taking effect on RenewsAt (empty: none).

fields.name: Provider
fields.description: Payment provider of the plan: coupon|blocks (empty: none).

fields.name: ProviderRef
fields.description: The provider's subscription reference; never a secret.

fields.name: CouponCode
fields.description: The code that pays or discounts the plan (empty: none).

fields.name: DiscountUntil
fields.description: ISO instant a partial discount applies to renewals through (card payments).

fields.name: StatusNote
fields.description: Plain notice shown with the status (e.g. why it is past due).

fields.name: PastDueSince
fields.description: ISO instant the plan became past due (empty otherwise).

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: credit|plan|discount (empty on coupons saved before kinds: credit plus the optional PlanKey).

fields.name: PlanKeys
fields.description: Plans a plan or discount code may be used for (empty: every paid plan).

fields.name: DurationMonths
fields.description: plan: months the code pays; discount: months the discount applies.

fields.name: PercentOff
fields.description: discount: whole percent off (0: none).

fields.name: AmountOffUsd
fields.description: discount: fixed USD off (0: none).

fields.name: PerPersonLimit
fields.description: How many times one person may use the code; 0 = no limit.
